name: @baseout/support
description: Baseout support portal — Starlight docs, support chat, tickets, public roadmap. Target: support.baseout.com.

scripts.emails:check: rm -rf .emails-check && mkdir -p .emails-check && mjml emails/*.mjml -o .emails-check/ --config.allowIncludes true --config.keepComments false && for f in emails/*.html; do diff "$f" ".emails-check/$(basename "$f")" || exit 1; done && rm -rf .emails-check
